title: Enterprise Semiconductor & Electronics Fab Yield RCA, Wafer Defect Map Clustering, AOI & Virtual Metrology (R2R) Agent

tiers.tier: Tier 1: Manual Yield Engineer Excel + Univariate SPC Charts
tiers.architecture: Sampling 1 physical metrology wafer per 25-wafer FOUP lot (4% coverage) + univariate 3-sigma SPC charts + manual cross-table SQL joins across 600 process steps

tiers.tier: Tier 2: Prompt-Only General LLM FDC Alarm Log Summarizer
tiers.architecture: Feeding raw Fault Detection & Classification (FDC) text logs into an LLM to guess which tool chamber caused a wafer sort yield drop

tiers.tier: Tier 3: Standalone Wafer-Map CNN Without Tool-Chamber Genealogy Graph
tiers.architecture: ResNet/ViT classifies wafer bin maps ('Edge-Ring', 'Scratch') but lacks multi-step MES chamber routing ANOVA or Reliance-Index-gated Virtual Metrology

tiers.tier: Tier 4: Spatial-Signature DBSCAN/ViT + Chamber Genealogy Causal Graph + RI-Gated Virtual Metrology + SECS/GEM R2R Agent
tiers.architecture: Polar-Coordinate Wafer Map DBSCAN/ViT + MES 600-Step Tool-Chamber Hypergraph ANOVA + Reliance-Index (RI>=0.85) Virtual Metrology + EWMA Run-to-Run (R2R) SECS/GEM Interlock

scenarios.scenario: Edge-Ring Yield Excursion Across 12 FOUP Lots (Isolating Etch Chamber #PM3 out of 600 Process Steps)
scenarios.question: Wafer probe tests show a crescent Edge-Ring failure at step 580; trace back across 600 prior lithography/etch/CVD steps to isolate the exact faulty chamber
scenarios.model_answer: Extract polar-coordinate Edge-Ring spatial signature via DBSCAN/ViT and execute Kruskal-Wallis / mutual-information graph search across MES chamber genealogy -> isolate Etch Tool ET-04 Chamber PM3 (RF match drift) in 21 minutes
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 1 manual engineer takes 36 hours of SQL joins while 14 more 25-wafer FOUPs ($1.1M value) run through the faulty etch chamber.

scenarios.scenario: 100% Wafer-Level Virtual Metrology (VM) with Reliance Index (RI) Out-of-Distribution Gate
scenarios.question: Predict post-CMP dielectric thickness across all 25 wafers in a FOUP from FDC trace sensors, and handle sudden slurry batch changes safely
scenarios.model_answer: Predict film thickness via PLS/XGBoost Virtual Metrology; compute Mahalanobis Reliance Index (RI); when RI < 0.85 after preventive maintenance, auto-route physical CD-SEM measurement
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 1 measures only 1 wafer per 25-wafer lot (missing wafer #14 excursion); un-gated VM blindly extrapolates after PM and feeds bad offsets into R2R.

scenarios.scenario: Automated Optical Inspection (AOI) Nuisance Color-Variation Filtering vs. Killer Particle Bridge
scenarios.question: Distinguish benign thin-film thickness color nuisance from a 45nm metal-line shorting bridge on high-NA EUV / advanced packaging wafers
scenarios.model_answer: Fuse CAD layout polygon criticality mask with multi-channel darkfield/brightfield SEM/AOI VLM; suppress non-conductive oxide color nuance (0.6% overkill, 0.0% killer escape)
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 1 pixel-threshold AOI flags benign oxide color variation as defects (18.5% false overkill), burying human review stations.

scenarios.scenario: SECS/GEM Run-to-Run (R2R) Recipe Offset Clamp & Tool Hold Interlock
scenarios.question: Apply EWMA deposition time adjustment to CVD chamber based on Virtual Metrology feedback without violating process-window recipe bounds
scenarios.model_answer: Clamp EWMA R2R recipe offset within certified +/-3.5% Spec Limit via SECS-II S16/S2 host command; if predicted drift exceeds clamp, trigger automatic MES Tool Hold
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 2 unconstrained agent suggests an uncalibrated -12% gas flow tweak that violates recipe qualification and scraps the entire lot.

perturbation_checks.check: Wafer Map Rotation & Mixed-Defect Superposition (Simultaneous Center-Bullseye + Robot-Arm Scratch)
perturbation_checks.perturbed: 97.9% Chamber Root-Cause Hit Rate | 0.38h RCA (Decomposed Polar Basis)

perturbation_checks.check: Post-Chamber-Clean Preventive Maintenance (PM) Sensor Distribution Shift
perturbation_checks.perturbed: 0.0% Unmeasured Lot Scrap Escape (RI Drops to 0.42 -> Forces Physical Metrology)

key_findings: Tier 4 (Polar Wafer-Map DBSCAN/ViT + 600-Step Chamber Genealogy Graph + Reliance-Index Virtual Metrology + SECS/GEM R2R Clamp) compresses yield excursion root-cause analysis from 36.0 hours to 0.35 hours (21 minutes) with 98.4% chamber hit accuracy.

Gating 100% wafer-level Virtual Metrology on a Mahalanobis Reliance Index (RI >= 0.85) eliminates unmeasured lot scrap escapes (0.0% vs. 7.8%) while dynamically routing physical metrology after chamber maintenance.

Overlaying CAD layout criticality masks onto AOI/SEM defect classifiers cuts false-positive review overkill from 18.5% to 0.6%, reducing monthly wafer scrap and metrology bottleneck cost from $940K to $115K (-87.8%).
